title: Khet Sathi map background: site/data/basemap/<id>.json
description: Owner's launch brief (2026-11-14): no outside request at runtime, so the map background is a NASA picture served with the site. One file per prepared field (id = the field id in index.json) and one for the world (id 'world'). Written by pipeline/fetch/basemap.py. The picture is in Web Mercator (EPSG:3857), the projection Leaflet uses, so L.imageOverlay(image, bounds) lines up exactly. image is relative to the site's root, like every path the site fetches.

bounds.description: [[south, west], [north, east]] in degrees, as Leaflet's imageOverlay takes them

native_zoom.description: The Leaflet zoom at which one picture pixel is one screen pixel; beyond it the picture is only enlarged

date.description: The day the picture was taken (UTC), or the month of a composite

attribution.description: Short credit for the map's corner (plain text)
